last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription neck and shoulder pain self-management topics. The main query set returned 174 unique PubMed PMIDs, 173 fetched article records, and 169 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 25780258, 37339388, 23117107, 21178832, 38415786, 39222507, 30759118, 27792118, 20536800, 31830313, 35962884, 39039345, 37368401, 37338972, 38848304, and 15846753. Sixteen retained references were added across 16 new entries. New entries cover neck stretching, strengthening, yoga, qigong, massage, acupuncture, spinal manipulation, cervical traction, heat/cold packs, TENS, low-level laser, kinesio taping, self-management, internet exercise, shoulder exercise, and shoulder acupuncture. Tai chi, relaxation training, breathing therapy, sleep-position therapy, and ergonomic workstation topics were linked to existing entries. Aerobic exercise, Pilates, mindfulness, acupressure, manual therapy, posture training, and shoulder massage topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
